title: nonconformance.v1
description: One non-conformance (SUP.1 BP6): a fault the reviewer or a person found outside a gate and left unfixed in its pull request, or a delivery that reached the main branch without the delivery desk, recorded as a fenced ```yaml nonconformance block in the body of a host issue labelled non-conformance. That a closed one names a merged fixing pull request is a rule of check_nonconformances_gate; its escalation (label escalated, an assignee) of check_escalations_gate.

found_in.description: The pull request the fault was found in, or that reached the main branch without the delivery desk.

commit.description: A commit that reached the main branch from no pull request: its SHA, 7 to 40 hexadecimal characters.

fixed_by.description: The merged pull request that fixed it; required before the issue is closed.
